name: @slopcad/cad-components
description: Reusable parametric CAD components (Phase 32): a serializable component contract plus parameterized components built exclusively on the public cad-core and cad-kernel surfaces. Database-free, React-free, and kernel-neutral — components build through the kernel-neutral execution surface, so the same component runs against any conforming kernel (directly in tests, or over the worker protocol in a browser).
